evals.name: management-is-not-execution
evals.prompt: Audit a reactor where quality plugins exist only under pluginManagement. CI runs test on one JDK, a JDK-activated quality profile never activates in required jobs, and coverage exists only as report-aggregate.
expectations: Identifies missing executable declarations/bindings and verifies effective children plus actual logs.
Does not treat aggregate reports as module threshold enforcement.
Documents and wires a complete wrapper verify command/profile into required CI.

evals.name: failsafe-and-argline
evals.prompt: Configure Maven unit/integration coverage. Surefire and Failsafe have custom JVM flags and another agent. Failsafe currently binds only integration-test; tests start child application JVMs.
expectations: Binds both Failsafe integration-test and verify with teardown through verify.
Preserves existing test JVM flags and other agents using suitable property composition and late evaluation.
Provides resolved empty defaults for supported noninstrumented paths.
Explicitly propagates instrumentation to child JVMs and uses safe data paths for concurrent writers.
Collects/checks required integration data separately or deliberately combines it.

evals.name: missing-and-stale-coverage
evals.prompt: After a green reactor build, remove the coverage agent and rerun verify without clean. It still succeeds. Implement enforcement without requiring coverage in the POM aggregator.
expectations: Resets intended execution/report data before suites or otherwise prevents stale evidence.
Adds failure guards for required suite data and expected analyzed population.
Keeps production-module floors and deliberate empty-module handling.
Proves missing unit and integration instrumentation fail for the intended reason.

evals.name: format-and-dependency-rules
evals.prompt: Improve build hygiene for an existing Maven project. A formatting execution uses apply during verify and a suggested Enforcer bundle conflicts with the project BOM.
expectations: Makes verify nonmutating and exposes an explicit local format command.
Uses the wrapper and project-owned exact plugin/engine pins.
Evaluates convergence, upper bounds, duplicates and bytecode checks individually rather than applying incompatible rules blindly.
Preserves compatible existing dependency management and proves chosen checks execute.
